trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum is a completion reward: it unlocks on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are earned. Work the roadmap stages in order and use this tracker to confirm you are truly at 54 of 55 before wondering what is left.

steps.text: Finish the main story and every chapter trophy first
Clear all 14 missable trophies before their windows close
Complete the collectibles, activities and free-roam counters
Check this tracker for any gap when you reach 54 of 55

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Complete Gone Fishing, the opening mission. It plays as the game’s introduction, so start a new game and follow the on-screen objectives until the mission-complete banner appears.

steps.text: Start a new game
Follow the opening objectives through Gone Fishing
Reach the mission-complete screen

sources: Push Square — GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Awarded for finishing Chapter 1. Push the main story forward, playing each chapter mission in order, and the trophy lands as the chapter wraps up.

steps.text: Play the story missions in order
Finish the last mission of Chapter 1
Wait for the chapter-complete confirmation

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Awarded for finishing Chapter 2. Keep following the main story markers after Chapter 1 and complete every mission the chapter puts in front of you.

steps.text: Continue the story into Chapter 2
Complete each Chapter 2 mission in order
Finish the chapter’s closing mission

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Awarded for finishing Chapter 3. Stay on the main path, clear the chapter’s missions as they unlock, and the trophy pops at the chapter’s end.

steps.text: Continue the story into Chapter 3
Complete each Chapter 3 mission in order
Finish the chapter’s closing mission

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Awarded for finishing Chapter 4. Work through the chapter’s missions in sequence; nothing optional is required, just the main story beats.

steps.text: Continue the story into Chapter 4
Complete each Chapter 4 mission in order
Finish the chapter’s closing mission

sources: Push Square — GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the game’s final mission. Before you start it, clear any missable strands you still need — a finale is the usual point of no return, and several side stories close once the ending begins.

steps.text: Clear outstanding missable strands before the finale
Start the final mission from its story marker
Play it through to the ending

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. It is a named story beat, so following the main path brings you to it; travel to its marker when it appears and play it through.

steps.text: Progress the story until Breakfast Run appears
Travel to its marker and start the mission
Finish all of its objectives

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist, a set-piece story mission. Play through its approach and escape beats as the mission directs and the trophy lands on completion.

steps.text: Start The Cartel Heist when the story offers it
Complete the heist’s approach objectives
Finish the escape and reach the mission-complete screen

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete Child’s Play, a named story mission. Follow the main story until it appears, then play it through to the end.

steps.text: Progress the story until Child’s Play appears
Travel to its marker and start the mission
Finish all of its objectives

sources: Push Square — GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete Headliners, a named story mission. It arrives through ordinary story progress; start it from its marker and complete every objective.

steps.text: Progress the story until Headliners appears
Travel to its marker and start the mission
Finish all of its objectives

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete VCIA Takedown, a named story mission centred on the airport authority. Follow the main story to it and play it through to completion.

steps.text: Progress the story until VCIA Takedown appears
Travel to its marker and start the mission
Finish all of its objectives

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory, a named story mission. It unlocks through the main campaign; play it from its marker through to the mission-complete screen.

steps.text: Progress the story until Operation Savage Glory appears
Travel to its marker and start the mission
Finish all of its objectives

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Attain 100% on the in-game completion counter — the long tail of the platinum. Story, strands, collectibles, activities, stunts and exploration all feed the percentage, so sweep category by category with the in-game checklist open and this tracker beside it.

steps.text: Open the in-game completion checklist in the pause menu
Finish the story and every side strand
Complete each collectible and activity category
Keep sweeping leftover categories until the counter reads 100%
steps.source: Push Square — GTA VI trophy guide

sources: Push Square — GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Natural play across the map adds up, but a reliable, repeatable stunt spot near a respawn point turns the tail into a short grind — log progress in this tracker each session so the count stays visible.

steps.text: Find stunt ramps and jumps while exploring
Settle on one quick, safe stunt you can repeat
Repeat it in batches, checking the running total
Keep going until 250 stunts are complete

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every type of activity once. Whenever a new activity icon appears on the map, play one round of it instead of driving past, and no category is left untried when the endgame arrives.

steps.text: Open the map legend and note every activity type
Play one round of each type as it unlocks
Use this tracker to confirm no type is missing

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge. Learn each range’s target patterns with a few practice runs first, then chase the golds one weapon class at a time so the muscle memory carries between attempts.

steps.text: Visit a shooting range and open its challenge list
Practice each challenge until the scoring pattern is clear
Replay challenges one weapon class at a time
Keep going until every medal is gold

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every location. Scout each course once at low speed to learn the gates, then run it flat out — a win needs first place, not a clean run.

steps.text: Find each Top Fun race start on the map
Scout the course and memorise its gates
Race again until you finish first
Repeat at every race location
steps.source: Push Square — GTA VI trophy guide

sources: Push Square — GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — repeating the same race does not add to the count. Enter every new race marker you unlock and bring a suitably fast vehicle for its class so first place is realistic.

steps.text: Enter each new race as it appears on the map
Use a competitive vehicle for the race class
Win and move on to a different race
Track the tally until 20 distinct races are won

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Take the challenge when Cal offers it, keep steady tension on the line without snapping it, and land your catch faster or heavier than his.

steps.text: Accept Cal’s fishing challenge when offered
Hook a fish and manage the line tension carefully
Land your catch to beat Cal’s result

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game from start to finish. Pick the shortest cabinet you can find in an arcade or bar, put a credit in, and play through to its end screen instead of walking away mid-game.

steps.text: Find an arcade cabinet in the world
Start a game and play a full session
Reach the game’s end or completion screen

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.missableNote: Andy’s strand runs alongside the story and can be overtaken by it: push the chapters too far before finishing his missions and his final mission may never be offered again on this save.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Andy’s strand. Work his missions as they appear instead of banking them for later, and close the strand out well before the endgame.

steps.text: Accept Andy’s missions as they appear
Complete each mission in his strand in order
Finish his final mission before the late-game chapters

sources: Push Square — GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.missableNote: Kenton’s strand can be closed off by story progress: leave his missions sitting while you advance the chapters and his final mission can disappear from the map for good.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Kenton’s strand. Treat each of his missions as urgent when it appears and finish the whole strand before driving the main story into its final act.

steps.text: Accept Kenton’s missions as they appear
Complete each mission in his strand in order
Finish his final mission before the late-game chapters

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.missableNote: Billy’s strand is on the story’s clock: advance too far without finishing his missions and the strand can end without ever offering its final mission.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Billy’s strand. Prioritise his missions over optional exploring whenever they are active and wrap the strand up before the endgame.

steps.text: Accept Billy’s missions as they appear
Complete each mission in his strand in order
Finish his final mission before the late-game chapters

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.missableNote: Stranger strands can lapse as the story moves on: a strand abandoned for several chapters may never offer its final mission again, and eight completed strands are needed.
trophies.guide: Complete eight full mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Each strand is a chain — finishing one mission unlocks that stranger’s next — so keep returning to the same question-mark icons until each chain ends.

steps.text: Start stranger missions at question-mark icons
Return to each stranger until their strand ends
Count off the strands until eight are complete

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.missableNote: Randy’s strand can be overtaken by the main story: his final mission is only offered while his strand is still open, and late chapters can close it.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Randy’s strand. Do his missions when they appear rather than saving them, and finish the strand before the story’s final stretch.

steps.text: Accept Randy’s missions as they appear
Complete each mission in his strand in order
Finish his final mission before the late-game chapters

sources: Push Square — GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.missableNote: Tyrone’s strand is tied to story progress: push too far ahead and his final mission may stop being offered, with no way back on the same save.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Tyrone’s strand. Keep his strand moving whenever a mission is available and close it out before the endgame.

steps.text: Accept Tyrone’s missions as they appear
Complete each mission in his strand in order
Finish his final mission before the late-game chapters

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida. The spots sit in quiet, scenic places; when you find one, stop and use the prompt, and mark regions off in this tracker so none of them is missed.

steps.text: Look for meditation spots at scenic overlooks
Use the meditate prompt at each spot you find
Sweep region by region until every spot is done

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.missableNote: Bret’s hunt depends on his strand still being active: leave the request too long while the story closes strands down and the hunt may never be offered again.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret sends you after. Accept his request, track the animal in its habitat, and bring it down to complete his ask.

steps.text: Take Bret’s hunting request
Travel to the animal’s habitat and track it
Hunt the unique animal and report back to Bret

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete three full Collectible Card sets. Cards hide in shops, landmarks and interiors all over Leonida; grab every one you spot from the first hour onwards so the sets fill in naturally as you explore.

steps.text: Pick up every collectible card you come across
Check which sets are closest to complete
Hunt down the missing cards to finish three sets

sources: Push Square — GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK It spot at 100 locations. These marked viewpoints are quick and free — whenever the prompt appears, stop and take the shot instead of driving on, and the hundred accumulates across the whole map.

steps.text: Watch for WAiNK It prompts at viewpoints
Stop and complete the photo at each spot
Keep a running tally until 100 locations are logged

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the game’s challenges. Challenges progress through ordinary play — driving, combat, exploration — so check the challenge list regularly and deliberately finish the ones that are nearly done.

steps.text: Open the challenges list in the pause menu
Note the challenges closest to completion
Target those activities until 50 challenges are complete

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.missableNote: This needs your partner beside you for a four-star escape, a pairing the story only guarantees early on — once the partners are separated by the plot, the setup may be impossible to recreate.
trophies.guide: Lose a four-star wanted level while your partner is with you, and escape. Raise your wanted level to four stars with your partner in the vehicle, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the stars fully clear.

steps.text: Ride with your partner in the same vehicle
Commit crimes until the wanted level reaches four stars
Break police line of sight and stay hidden
Let the wanted level clear completely while still together

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.missableNote: Chaining three shop robberies under one wanted level needs your partner present, and the partnership is an early-game arrangement — later story beats can take the partner away and close the window.
trophies.guide: Rob three shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level in between. Plan a tight triangle of shops, keep the wanted level alive as you move between them, and only escape after the third robbery.

steps.text: Pick three shops close together
Rob the first shop with your partner present
Drive straight to the second and third, keeping the wanted level
Escape only after the third robbery
steps.source: Push Square — GTA VI trophy guide

sources: Push Square — GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles by getting into them. Variety is what counts, not ownership: sit in every new model you see parked or driving, and busy districts and parking lots move the count quickly.

steps.text: Enter every unfamiliar vehicle model you see
Check parking lots and affluent areas for rare models
Keep going until 100 vehicles are discovered

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down five enemies in a single Combat Focus activation. Save the ability for a crowded fight, position so several enemies are visible at once, then trigger it and chain your shots before the meter drains.

steps.text: Save Combat Focus for a fight with five or more enemies
Position so several enemies are in view at once
Activate Combat Focus and down five enemies before it ends

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.missableNote: The chance comes around a story visit to VCIA airport: leave the airport the intended way and the unscheduled-departure moment is gone for this playthrough.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — in practice, take an aircraft from the airport and get airborne outside any mission script, rather than using the exit the game intends for you.

steps.text: Reach VCIA airport during free access or its story beat
Find an unattended aircraft on the tarmac
Take off without clearance to trigger the departure

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: This one revolves around Rhino tanks — “kinda hot in these Rhinos” is the whole brief. The reliable route is to draw a military-level response, engage the Rhino that shows up with heavy weapons or take it over, and survive the encounter.

steps.text: Draw a heavy response so a Rhino is deployed
Engage the Rhino with heavy weapons, or commandeer it
Survive the encounter until the trophy pops

sources: Push Square — GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Case the store first, go in quietly, keep staff and cameras from raising the alarm, and be gone before anyone realises what happened.

steps.text: Choose a jewelry store and watch its routine
Enter without drawing attention and mind camera sightlines
Take the goods and leave before an alarm is raised

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape each time. Treat every vault as a mini-heist: get in, clear the vault, grab the cash, and have an escape vehicle ready before the response arrives.

steps.text: Locate a bank with an accessible vault
Reach the vault and empty it
Escape the police response
Repeat at five different banks

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Block its route with a heavy vehicle, deal with the guards quickly, force the rear doors, take the cash and vanish before the response builds.

steps.text: Spot an armored truck on its route
Block it and neutralise the guards
Open the rear doors and take the cash
Escape and lose the wanted level

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida until the whole map is uncovered. Ride each highway out to the state’s edges, cross the water to the outlying islands, and sweep any grey patches left on the map late in the game.

steps.text: Drive or fly into every greyed-out area of the map
Visit the islands and rural corners of the state
Check the map until every area is uncovered

sources: Push Square — GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang. Operations sit in each gang’s own turf, so identify which gang runs a site before you hit it — the goal is coverage of every gang, not repeats of the easiest one.

steps.text: Identify operations run by different gangs
Rob one operation in each gang’s turf
Track the gangs covered until every gang is hit

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.missableNote: A quiet early-game moment on Ocean Beach: the opening hours put you right there, and once the story pulls you away from the beach, this exact moment may not come back.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to a beachfront bar on Ocean Beach early in the game, order a cocktail, and take in the view when the moment is offered.

steps.text: Visit Ocean Beach early in the game
Find a beachfront bar or stand
Order a cocktail and enjoy the view

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style: get into one of the display cars inside a showroom and drive it straight out through the glass frontage.

steps.text: Enter a vehicle showroom
Get into one of the display cars
Accelerate out through the front glass

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley: visit the alley, start a game of bowling and play your frames. The trophy is about showing up and playing, not about winning.

steps.text: Travel to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley
Start a bowling game
Play through your frames

sources: Push Square — GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.missableNote: This partnership moment is tied to a story beat with your partner that the plot moves past — try for it while the partnership is active early in the game, because it may not be repeatable later.
trophies.guide: A hidden partnership trophy with “mass appeal”: stay alert during the early partner missions and take any optional joint activity the game offers the two of you, rather than rushing straight to the objective.

steps.text: Play the early partner missions attentively
Take optional partner activities when they are offered
Experiment with joint actions until it pops

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make choices whenever the game asks — dialogue picks, mercy-or-payback decisions, business calls. The tracked count rewards volume, so never skip a choice prompt; decide deliberately every time one appears.

steps.text: Take every dialogue and decision prompt you meet
Make the choices side content offers as well
Keep choosing until the tracked count is reached

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.missableNote: Second time’s the charm: if the trigger is succeeding on a retry, then acing the relevant event on your first attempt skips it entirely — this one can only be earned on a second try.
trophies.guide: Succeed at something on your second attempt after failing it once. When a race, challenge or event beats you, retry it immediately and win the rematch — the trophy rewards the comeback, not the clean run.

steps.text: Attempt a challenge or event and let a first try fail
Retry the same event right away
Win on the second attempt

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.missableNote: A one-off strange event: it happens once, at its set place or moment, and if you drive past or the moment passes, it does not repeat on this save.
trophies.guide: Witness something strange out in Leonida. Explore the odd corners of the map at night — remote swamps, rooftops, lonely roads — and when something unexplained starts, stay and watch it play out instead of leaving.

steps.text: Explore remote spots at night
Investigate anything unexplained you stumble on
Stay until the strange event finishes

sources: Push Square — GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl a pedestrian over with a melee drive-by: swing a melee weapon from a moving vehicle so it clips someone as you pass. A bike at moderate speed gives the cleanest angle — knock them down without running them over outright.

steps.text: Equip a melee weapon and get on a bike or in a car
Ride past a pedestrian at moderate speed
Swing the melee weapon as you pass to knock them down

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from scores and robberies; instead of spending them raw, pass them to your laundering contacts until the laundered total reaches the mark.

steps.text: Collect Marked Bills from robberies and scores
Deliver them to your laundering contacts
Repeat until $250,000 has been laundered

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Clothing, weapons, vehicles, food and services all count, so spend naturally as you play — and if the total lags late in the game, a few big purchases close the gap fast.

steps.text: Buy gear and services as you play
Keep an eye on the tracked spend total
Make a few large purchases if you fall short of $100,000

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase every garage property on the market. Garages are bought through the property listings; fund them from scores, buy as they become affordable, and sweep the listings late in the game for any you skipped.

steps.text: Open the property listings and note every garage
Buy garages as your cash allows
Purchase the last remaining garages to complete the set

sources: Push Square — GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Whenever you acquire a new vehicle, open the app and register it on the spot — ten registrations accumulate quickly if you do it as you go instead of in one batch.

steps.text: Open the Scooter Bros app when you get a vehicle
Register the vehicle in the app
Repeat until 10 vehicles are registered
